blocks.text: Hello — this is Blind Flange running in replay mode. This response is authored for the Phase 0 prototype, not captured from a live run.
I'll turn the ingested inspection report into key findings. Setting up a goal to track this, then reading the report's OCR output before I say anything about its content.

arguments.objective: Extract key findings, each with page-and-region provenance, from the ingested inspection report (sample-inspection-report.pdf)

blocks.text:
156 OCR lines came back across 2 pages. Two carry Major severity in Section 3 and are both named again in the Conclusion — those are the key findings:

1. E-1104A — insulation cladding open at the channel end, corrosion under insulation suspected over a 1.2 m run. Major. Source: page 1, region left 560 top 2048 width 814 height 58. Recommended action: strip cladding and UT scan before restart.

2. PSV-2207A — relief-valve test tag expired 04-2026, no current bench certificate held against this tag in the register. Major. Source: page 1, region left 560 top 2171 width 876 height 60. Recommended action: withdraw and bench test; fit spare.

Both are cross-referenced in the report's own Conclusion (page 2, region left 178 top 1342 width 2030 height 65): a non-conformance report is to be raised against PSV-2207A, which is operating outside its certification interval.
Findings recorded against the ingested report; the goal is marked complete.
This is an authored replay response for the Phase 0 prototype (ADR-0001, 28 August 2026 amendment). It stands in for real local inference until that runs on day 4.
